step1_figure.page: Not provided in prompt (Standard Baker CMOS textbook figures)
step1_figure.circuit_type: Folded-Cascode OTA driving a Sallen-Key Low-Pass Filter
step1_figure.description: A folded-cascode operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) providing high DC gain, followed by a unity-gain Sallen-Key active low-pass filter for high-frequency attenuation.

open_loop_gain.description: Low-frequency open-loop voltage gain of the OTA

equation.explanation: G_m is the transconductance of the input diff pair. R_out is the parallel combination of the top and bottom cascode output impedances.
equation.assumptions: Assumes OTA is not heavily resistively loaded at DC.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail = 10uA -> I_D1 = 5uA. g_m1 = sqrt(2 * up*Cox * (W/L) * I_D) = sqrt(2 * 50u * 10 * 5u) = 70.7 uA/V. r_o = 1/(lambda*I_D) = 1/(0.1 * 5u) = 2 MOhm. R_out = (g_m * r_o) * r_o / 2 = (70.7u * 2M) * 1M = 141 MOhm. A_OL = 70.7u * 141M = 10,000 V/V = 80 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the exact W/L ratios and channel length modulation (lambda) of the SKY130 devices.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency at which the open-loop gain drops to 0 dB (1 V/V)

equation.explanation: Determined by the input transconductance and the total load capacitance seen by the OTA.
equation.assumptions: Assumes non-dominant poles are at higher frequencies.

sky130_expected.calculation: G_m = 70.7 uA/V. The filter presents an effective high-frequency capacitive load of roughly C1||C2 = 12 pF. f_un = 70.7u / (2 * pi * 12p) = 937 kHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The Sallen-Key filter heavily loads the OTA at high frequencies, reducing the effective bandwidth compared to a purely 1pF load.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage

equation.explanation: Limited by the maximum current the tail source can charge/discharge into the load capacitance.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the folding branch can sink the full tail current.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail = 10 uA. C_L (effective) = 12 pF. SR = 10uA / 12pF = 0.83 V/us.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on the exact effective capacitance presented by the filter during large-signal transients.

power_consumption.description: Total static power dissipated by the circuit

equation.explanation: Sum of currents in the tail branch and the two folding branches multiplied by supply voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_tail = 10 uA. Assuming folding branches are biased at ~10 uA each, I_tot = 30 uA. P = 1.8V * 30uA = 54 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Folding branch currents depend on the exact VBN/VBP bias voltages and device sizing.

filter_cutoff_frequency.description: -3dB frequency of the Sallen-Key low-pass filter

equation.formula: f_c = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(R1 * R2 * C1 * C2))
equation.explanation: Corner frequency of the 2nd-order RC network.
equation.assumptions: Assumes the buffer is ideal (gain=1) and OTA output impedance is negligible compared to R1.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined entirely by the passive components R1, R2, C1, C2 in the netlist.

step3_testbench.description: Measures OTA open-loop gain, unity-gain frequency, phase margin, slew rate, power, and filter cutoff frequency using a closed-loop configuration to maintain DC bias.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Folded-Cascode OTA and Filter Testbench
.lib ${SKY130_PDK} tt

* Parameter definitions for parameterized netlist
.param W_XM1=10 L_XM1=1
.param W_XM2=10 L_XM2=1
.param W_XM3=5 L_XM3=1
.param W_XM4=5 L_XM4=1
.param W_XM5=5 L_XM5=1
.param W_XM6=5 L_XM6=1
.param W_XM7=10 L_XM7=1
.param W_XM8=10 L_XM8=1
.param W_XM9=10 L_XM9=1
.param W_XM10=10 L_XM10=1

* Include the DUT netlist (assumed to be pasted here or .included)
* .include folded_cascode.spice

* Stimulus and Feedback
* Pulse for transient, AC=1 for AC analysis, DC=0.9V for bias
V_inp VINP_NODE 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(0.4 1.4 10n 1n 1n 5u 10u)

* Close the loop around the OTA for stable DC bias and Transient
R_fb VINN_NODE XOTA.VOTA_OUT 0.01

.control
* 1. Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1 100Meg

* Extract Open-Loop OTA metrics from Closed-Loop simulation
let Vdiff = v(VINP_NODE) - v(VINN_NODE)
let A_OL = v(XOTA.VOTA_OUT) / Vdiff
let gain_db = 20 * log10(mag(A_OL))
let phase = 180/PI * cph(A_OL)

meas ac dc_gain_db find gain_db at=10
meas ac unity_gain_freq when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac pm_deg find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Extract Filter metrics
let filter_complex = v(VOUT_NODE) / v(XOTA.VOTA_OUT)
let filter_gain_db = 20 * log10(mag(filter_complex))
meas ac filter_dc_gain find filter_gain_db at=10
let filter_target_db = filter_dc_gain - 3
meas ac filter_cutoff when filter_gain_db=filter_target_db fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis
tran 10n 10u
meas tran slew_rate_rise trig v(XOTA.VOTA_OUT) val=0.6 rise=1 targ v(XOTA.VOTA_OUT) val=1.2 rise=1
let sr_rise = (1.2 - 0.6) / slew_rate_rise
print sr_rise

quit
.endc
